lesson.subtitle: Lesson 15 -- First Month Done
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 15 -- First Month Done

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, this is Linda. Congratulations, one month in Miami! The team is very happy with your work. On Monday, at nine, there is the team meeting, on the fifth floor. Please introduce yourself and your area. Two minutes, no more. There are twelve people in the meeting, and they are very friendly. And Ricardo, your English is better every week. See you on Monday!

Hi, it's Paul. A small piece of advice for your introduction on Monday. In the United States, an introduction is short. Say your name, your job, and one thing about you. Your family, your city, or a hobby. Smile, and speak slowly. Slow is good. Nobody wants a long speech at nine in the morning. And at the end, say: thank you, I am happy to be here.

extra_audio.text: Good morning, everybody. My name is Ricardo. I am from São Paulo, Brazil. I work in exchange, and my clients are companies. There are twenty-five people on my team. Thank you. I am happy to be here!
